title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go, parity & v1.73.0 release
author: Ava Kim
release_notes: Patch release: unify auth/retries behavior and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; parity fixes and version bump to v1.73.0.
description: Motivation: Multiple SDKs (python, typescript, go) had subtle behavioral differences around auth retry logic and streaming ergonomics which caused production parity issues and developer confusion. This PR unifies the surface area: (1) standardizes auth token refresh flow and retry/backoff semantics, (2) harmonizes streaming API ergonomics (async iterators in Python, readable streams in TS, channel helpers in Go), (3) fixes parity inconsistencies in error codes and wrapper helpers, and (4) bumps SDK versions to v1.73.0. Changes aim to be backwards-compatible ergonomically but tighten correctness for token refresh during long-lived streams. Checklist: - [x] Unify auth+retry logic across SDKs and centralize backoff config - [x] Streaming ergonomics: expose consistent semantics and helpers in each SDK - [x] Add integration tests exercising long-lived streams with token rotation - [x] Update CHANGELOGs and bump versions to v1.73.0 - [x] Manual smoke test on hosted API + Dedicated deploys Notes: token refresh now occurs transparently for streaming connections; if refresh fails the SDK emits a standardized error (SDKAuthError) and attempts N final retries according to config. Callers wanting previous behavior can set legacy_retry_mode=true in client options. Linear/Jira: ENG-2345 implements the core runtime hooks referenced in this PR; SUP-1123 is a customer-reported case that motivated additional tests. CI: full test matrix run (py 3.9/3.11, node 16/18, go 1.20) and linters. Merge: squash and merge to main.
commits: Unify auth retry handler across SDKs
Integration tests for token rotation in streams
